profile.name: Edward Forst
profile.description: GSA administrator responsible for federal procurement agreements with AI providers.

web.named_query: ("Scott Kupor" OR "Edward Forst") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: In October 2025 nomination testimony, Edward Forst said GSA must continue leading government technology transformation and that the administration had prioritized responsible and accelerated AI adoption. He also described GSA as deploying secure, mission-ready AI through OneGov and the USAi platform while emphasizing protection of data and privacy and thoughtful implementation. As GSA Administrator in 2026, Forst promoted OneGov agreements with OpenAI and Snowflake as secure frameworks for agencies to adopt AI at scale and accelerate mission-tailored AI tools. At an October 2025 hearing, he said he had not been part of decisions to bring in particular AI technologies and committed to reviewing the selection process and facts.
